GPU scheduling refers to how the GPU resources are allocated to different parts of the model. If the scheduling is not efficient, it can lead to overutilization of the GPU, which can cause performance issues. Proper scheduling is essential to balance the load.

Autoscaling is the process of dynamically adjusting the number of GPUs or resources based on the model's performance.
